Tier: T1
Why: A bounded Home action fix routes existing workout labels to their existing screens, without changing access, logging, or navigation registration.
T4 trigger scan: none; no auth, tenancy, privacy, money, credentials, destructive data, or server-write changes.
T3 trigger scan: none; existing registered routes and route contracts only.
Bounded T1: YES; Home state and handler, two existing regression/parity test files, and one matching README row.
Canonical builder: GPT-6.1 Sol.
Parent owner: operator agent 129.
Acceptance evidence: `HomeScreen.honestCopy127.test.tsx` and `assignedWorkoutEntry127.test.tsx` exercise exact assignment IDs, saved-session route parameters, state-driven copy and existing Home actions; failing-first and passing-after results recorded below.
Promotion triggers: Any change to entitlement checks, workout persistence, backend contracts, or navigator registration requires re-grading and routing.

## What changes for coaches/clients
- Tapping `Start <plan name>` opens that specific pending coach workout's existing review/start screen instead of the Train root.
- Tapping `Resume workout` opens the saved live workout directly with `resume: true`, carrying its own name, exercise payload and assignment ID.
- A saved workout is reachable from Home even when no workout history or pending coach assignment exists.
- Open Train, food logging, profile completion, refresh and Home's supporting sections remain available.

## B / U list
- B: none in this assigned scope.
- U7 (`FW-TRAIN-128:HOME-START-128`): Home's Start/Resume labels previously led to the Train root instead of the named workout; saved-only sessions previously showed Log a meal.

## Base / collision discipline
Based on main and intentionally minimal: only `HomeScreen.tsx`, its existing Home-copy test, the legacy `src/__tests__/assignedWorkoutEntry127.test.tsx` destination assertion, and the Home row in `src/screens/client/README.md`.
Merged `origin/main` at `e634d19e2869e775cc80367732718caba8b371ba` before the opening push, and freshly confirmed it is still included before the completed test correction. Diff against main: +90/-24 = 114 changed lines (39 source, 73 tests, 2 documentation).
Before editing, fetched Git refs and listed each open mobile PR's files with `git diff --name-only origin/main...origin/<branch>` using the operator board. No open PR held HomeScreen or this test.
The README is shared with several open PRs, so the documentation diff is one Home-row update.
`ClientNavigator.tsx` (m#521), `ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx` (m#521) and `HomeHeaderActions.tsx` (m#523), plus their tests, are untouched. No new route, dependency, lockfile change, backend dependency or production change.

## Routes/actions before -> after
| Label / action | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Start the named pending coach workout | Train root, then coach-card/detail taps | MoreTab → WorkoutAssignmentDetail with the exact pending assignment ID; its existing review/Start flow is retained |
| Resume workout (history or pending assignments exist) | Train root | WorkoutTab → ActiveWorkout with the saved name/exercises/assignment and `resume: true` |
| Saved workout with no history or assignments | Log a meal | Resume workout → the same saved ActiveWorkout |
| Open Train (completed today, history, unnamed plan or failed reads) | WorkoutTab | Unchanged |
| Log a meal (no saved/history/pending workout) | Log | Unchanged |
| Missing calories/protein/carbs/fat metric prompt | Log | Unchanged in simple/full modes |
| Complete your profile | MoreTab → EditProfile | Unchanged |
| Pull-to-refresh / day-data Retry | Reload today's food data and profile; refresh workout reads | Unchanged |
| Message coach / notification bell / flag-gated Roman header entry | Messages / NotificationCenter / MoreTab → RomanChat | HomeHeaderActions integration unchanged |
| Failed-payment Update card / Message coach | Existing DunningBanner handlers | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Coachless enter/use code / Not now / code sheet / plan selection / Message coach | Existing CoachlessHomeSlot handlers and sheets | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Pending invite Attach / Dismiss | Existing claim/clear handlers | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Push Enable / Not now | Existing permission/token registration / dismiss | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Coach introduction dismiss | Existing persisted dismissal | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Full-macros intro dismiss | Existing persisted dismissal | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Tutorial resume / Message your coach | Tutorial RESUME / Messages | Unchanged component and Home integration |
| Holistic insights | Read-only without a supplied press handler | Unchanged |

Parity proof: the changed Home test file asserts exact Start/Resume/Open Train/Log destinations, the first unfinished assignment, saved-workout priority, failed-read fallback, profile/metric/header actions, refresh and all supporting-section order. Supporting components and their props are unchanged; their existing module tests stay intact.

## Truthful sweep
- Start's name and destination come from the same confirmed pending assignment.
- Resume appears only after a saved session is read for the current user and uses that session's identity.
- A completed workout today continues to offer Open Train, not a new completion or plan claim.
- Failed reads retain a neutral Open Train action, never an invented plan or completion.
- Accessibility hints describe the actual destination.
- Existing one-primary-action, semantic theme colours, typography, metrics, flags and section order remain unchanged.
- No first-person copy, exclamation marks, emoji, hard-coded colours, removed routes or styling changes added.

## Tests
- Failing-first against unchanged `HomeScreen.tsx` on main `a1be6fb25538b02e961fd379a0d86d71d610ad7a`, via `ops/heavy.sh`: 5 failed / 12 passed. Behavioral proof: `opens the first unfinished assignment` expected the specific `WorkoutAssignmentDetail`, but received only `WorkoutTab`; `active-assigned` expected saved-session parameters and `resume: true`, but received only `WorkoutTab`; `active-only` could not find Resume because Home showed Log. The first cold mount timed out and disrupted the following active case; those two noisy failures are not used as the proof.
- Passing-after: all 17 tests pass in the same single file through `ops/heavy.sh`, including a rerun after merging current main at opening head `a6cb635989060b2061df14e21707c4047afd7a31`.
- Opening [CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37701595332/job/113066079227) passed lint and typecheck; 702/703 suites and 9,269/9,270 tests passed. The only failure was the legacy Home-entry assertion requiring the old Train-root destination. It now requires `WorkoutAssignmentDetail` with the exact `PLAN.id`; no assertion was weakened and no production code changed for this correction.
- The corrected legacy entry test file passes 15/15 through `ops/heavy.sh`; each local run used one changed file at a time (32 targeted tests total across the two files).
- Full-project typecheck, lint and tests: CI only; no local full suite.
- No device or production test claimed.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 (LN-OPUS-A3-129) — growth-project-mobile#524 @ 0eca5fc2758b2fd77cb8d0d83379ccd68310f486 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Full review. 4 files, +90/-24 (114 lines). CI is green and there is no conflict with main 1d0564ff.

B1 — Home's Start and Resume make the target the only screen of a tab stack that has not opened yet.
- User story: a client whose phone closed the app mid-workout reopens it and taps "Resume workout" on Home, then leaves the workout or finishes it offline. The Train tab keeps showing that old workout screen instead of Train, and the client cannot get back to Train until they force-quit the app. "Start <plan>" does the same to the You tab: it then shows the assignment instead of the You menu (Settings, Profile, Sign out).
- Where: `src/screens/client/HomeScreen.tsx:320-326` `navigate('WorkoutTab', { screen: 'ActiveWorkout', params })` and `:330-333` `navigate('MoreTab', { screen: 'WorkoutAssignmentDetail', params })`, both without `initial: false`. Bottom tabs are lazy (ClientNavigator sets no `lazy` override), so right after launch neither stack is mounted, and React Navigation renders the named screen as the stack's only route. ActiveWorkout's leave and queued-finish paths call `goBack()` (`ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx:1045,1061,1170` on main). That bubbles up to the tab navigator, and the stale screen stays as Train's root (tab re-press runs popToTop, which does nothing). This is new: on main, Home opened Train's root, and Resume was pushed on top of WorkoutMain.
- Smallest fix: add `initial: false` to both calls (as m#523 did for Roman, `HomeHeaderActions.tsx:116`), and update the two test expectations. Optional, because the gap exists on main already: the same flag on the assignment's Start (`WorkoutAssignmentDetailScreen.tsx:140`).

Otherwise the review is clean: the destinations match the parity table, the hints and copy are state-driven and truthful, and the routes exist (`WorkoutAssignmentDetail` in the More stack, `ActiveWorkout` in the Workout stack).

Cs:
- C: `assignmentId` and `resume` are not in main's `ActiveWorkout` param type (`ClientNavigator.tsx:228`). On main the screen still shows its restore prompt; with m#521 it resumes directly. Either way the result is safe.
